compilerOptions.$comment: Do NOT map the ten ADR 023 domain packages or client-vue here. Each shell needs a different allowlist and paths is one flat map, so a global mapping resolves every sibling and defeats the §3 direction guard in the editor — the build config would still catch it, but only in CI. A legal reach resolves through the package's own dependencies and its exports field, with no mapping needed. Removing an entry here is a decision, not an omission.
